tools.name: start_here

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who is calling: tier, trial state, corpus load count. Pass trial_id from connect() to confirm the handle used for assessments and private workflows. After connect, call start_here or list_regulations.

Record one structured applicability verdict on a regulation pinpoint for this keyless trial_id (from connect). Verdicts: applicable | not_applicable | needs_review | deferred

tools.name: publish_workflow
tools.description: Sign-in required: call connect(email) and connect_verify first (free, one email) unless this connection is already signed in. Mark one of this trial_id private playbooks ready or draft. Publishing is private state only; it never adds content to the shipped library or another trial.

tools.name: delete_workflow
tools.description: Sign-in required: call connect(email) and connect_verify first (free, one email) unless this connection is already signed in. Delete one private workflow for this trial_id. It cannot delete a shipped playbook or a draft owned by another trial.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rekvira_account, record_assessment, list_assessments, submit_feedback, notifications, list_regulations, search_regulation, search_regulations, lookup_obligations, read_unit, list_workflows, get_workflow · Private data: connect, whoami, record_assessment, list_workflows, save_workflow, publish_workflow, delete_workflow · Public sink: connect, connect_verify, rekvira_account, start_here, record_assessment, list_assessments, submit_feedback, notifications, list_regulations, search_regulation, search_regulations, lookup_obligations, verify_citation, read_unit, list_workflows, get_workflow, save_workflow, publish_workflow, delete_workflow · Destructive: rekvira_account, notifications, delete_workflow.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
